check_unextracted_tip: Checks apps that have neither a decrypted nor an original IPA in the output folders yet (using the current file name settings).
hint: Tip: click ☐ or double-click a row to check it; Shift-click ☐ to check a range. Select rows with Ctrl/Shift, then press Space or right-click to check them. Click the ☐ header to check every shown app.
d_app: Name: {name}    Bundle ID: {bundle}    Version: {version}    Build: {build}    PID: {pid}
d_enc_yes: Yes (original IPAs keep the executable encrypted)
d_offloaded: Offloaded: only a placeholder remains on the device, so this app cannot be extracted. Reinstall it from the App Store first.
extract_tip: Packs the installed app as-is (executables stay encrypted); needs SSH only. For apps that can't launch or crash, so they can't be decrypted. Installs on devices using the same Apple ID or with AppSync.
dump_tip: Makes an IPA whose executables are decrypted; installs on other devices after re-signing, or with AppSync on jailbroken ones. Needs frida-server on the device. The decryption mode is set in Settings → Frida.
err_preflight: App can't launch (failed preflight checks; licence may be invalid, re-download it)
err_closed: Frida connection closed (app may have crashed or blocks Frida)
err_session: App exited right after launch (crash or anti-debugging)
err_resume: Frida could not start the app (unlock the device and keep the screen on)
err_path: Local file error (antivirus may have blocked a file)
close_after: Close each app after decrypting it (avoids running out of memory in large batches)
separate_dirs: Keep decrypted and original IPAs in separate folders
name_help: "Type" for decrypted IPAs follows the check of every executable: decrypted, partial-64bit-decrypted (only 32-bit slices still encrypted) or partial-decrypted; for original IPAs it is encrypted (original if the executable was never encrypted). Leave out .ipa; an empty version becomes unknown.
name_empty: the file name cannot be empty
frida_help: These settings are only used by "Extract decrypted IPA"; original IPAs do not need Frida. Connect also connects Frida when the chosen mode can be used.
restart_frida: Restart frida-server and retry on Frida errors
log_ready: Ready. Enter the device IP, SSH account and password, then click Connect.
log_loaded: {total} apps ({user} user apps); reading signature details…
log_sftp_failed: Could not open SFTP for signature details: {error}
log_frida_skipped: No valid frida-ios-dump folder, so Frida is not connected (original IPAs still work).
log_no_server: Install frida-server on the device (add https://build.frida.re in Sileo/Cydia) and make sure it is running.
log_minor: Note: frida patch versions differ ({local} vs {device}); if extraction fails, open Settings → Frida and click "Install Frida dependencies".
log_frida_ok: Frida connected through SSH tunnel (local 127.0.0.1:{local} → device {remote}).
log_start: Extracting {n} decrypted IPA(s). Keep the device unlocked with the screen on.
log_relaunch: [{bundle}] already running (PID {pid}); closing it so it starts fresh. Frida often cannot attach to a suspended background app.
log_finished: Decrypted IPAs finished: {ok} / {total} succeeded. Output folder: {dir}
log_extract_finished: Original IPAs finished: {ok} / {total} succeeded. Output folder: {dir}
log_download_done: frida-ios-dump downloaded; Frida dependencies still need installing.
m_ports: SSH port and Frida port must be numbers.
m_user: Enter the SSH account: usually root on rootful jailbreaks (unc0ver, checkra1n) and mobile on rootless ones (Dopamine, palera1n rootless).
m_none: Check one or more apps in the list.
m_name:
{kind} file name is invalid: {error}

Fix it in Settings → Extraction.
m_dup:
These apps would get the same file name. Add a field such as Bundle ID to the file name in Settings → Extraction:

{files}
m_busy: Cancel or wait for the extraction to finish before disconnecting.
m_close: An extraction is still running. Close and abort it?
m_cancel: Cancel now? The app currently being processed will be aborted.
m_paused:
{n} apps in a row failed with Frida connection errors, so the batch was paused.

Reboot (or respring) the device, then click "Check failed apps" and try again.
m_no_dump_dir: The frida-ios-dump folder is not set, so decrypted IPAs cannot be extracted. Set it, or click "Install frida-ios-dump", in Settings → Frida.
m_dump_dir_busy:
This folder exists and is not empty, so it cannot be downloaded here. Click "Install frida-ios-dump" in Settings → Frida to choose another location:

{path}
inst_device_no_ssh: Same as device frida-server (SSH not connected, version unknown)
inst_device_missing: Same as device frida-server (frida-server is not installed on the device)
inst_fetch_failed: Could not get the version list from PyPI: {error}
log_frida_versions: Device frida-server: {device} ({state}); frida versions on this computer: {local}
log_frida_missing: No frida {major}.x is installed on this computer, which device frida-server {device} needs.
inst_installed: frida versions on this computer (the one matching each device is picked automatically):
inst_reinstall: This version is already installed; installing it again replaces it.
inst_other_major: Note: its major version differs from device frida-server {device}, so it will only be used with other devices.
inst_will_run: These commands will run on this computer (frida goes into its own folder under {path}; npm install needs Node.js):
log_verify_ok: [{bundle}] Verified: all {n} Mach-O files are decrypted.
log_verify_partial: [{bundle}] Verified: {n} of {total} Mach-O files are still encrypted ({status}):
check_partial_tip: Check apps whose decrypted IPA still has encrypted files: verified in this session, or found in the output folder under a partial-decrypted / partial-64bit-decrypted file name (needs {{type}} in the file name).
log_rename_failed: Could not rename the IPA to {path}: {error}
log_partial_summary: {n} IPA(s) are only partially decrypted; "Check partially decrypted apps" selects them.
reason_slice32: 32-bit slice; this device runs only the 64-bit slice, so it was never decrypted
reason_watch: Watch app; it does not run on this device
reason_appex: app extension; it runs in its own process, which frida-ios-dump does not decrypt
reason_framework: framework/library the app had not loaded yet
reason_other: not loaded by the app while it was dumped
d_verify_ok: Decryption check: all {n} Mach-O files are decrypted
d_verify_partial32: Decryption check: {n} of {total} Mach-O files still have encrypted 32-bit slices (all 64-bit code is decrypted)
d_verify_partial: Decryption check: {n} of {total} Mach-O files are still encrypted
repair_tip: After each decrypted IPA, files that are still encrypted (app extensions, frameworks the app had not loaded, 32-bit slices) are decrypted on the device and patched into the IPA. iOS 15 and earlier decrypt any of them; iOS 16 and later only app extensions. The app on the device must be the same version as the IPA.
stage_repair: decrypting {n} remaining file(s) on the device
log_repair_start: [{bundle}] Decrypting {n} still-encrypted file(s) on the device…
log_repair_done: [{bundle}] Decrypted on the device: {n} of {total} file(s).
log_repair_failed: [{bundle}] Could not decrypt the remaining files on the device: {error}
reason_repair_missing: not found in the app on the device ({error})
reason_repair_mismatch: the file on the device differs from the one in the IPA, so the installed app is another version (sizes {error})
reason_repair_nokey: the device has no key for it; usually the app was not installed with this device's Apple ID, e.g. from an already decrypted or re-signed IPA ({error})
reason_repair_frida: could not attach to the app with Frida ({error})
dump_method_frida_direct: Direct decryption mode (iOS 16+ loads the app suspended)
dump_method_frida_ios_dump_tip: frida-ios-dump launches each app and copies its decrypted code from memory. Needs the frida-ios-dump folder. Keep the device unlocked.
dump_method_frida_direct_tip: Copies the installed app and decrypts every executable on the device without running it, so apps that crash on launch work too (except apps without a decryption key). iOS 15 and earlier: every file. iOS 16 and later: the app and its extensions (they are started suspended, and Settings is opened briefly for Safari extensions); frameworks and Watch apps stay encrypted. Does not need frida-ios-dump.
log_start_direct: Extracting {n} decrypted IPA(s) without running the apps.
reason_repair_unsupported_slice: this device does not load this architecture, so on iOS 16 and later it cannot be decrypted
reason_repair_unsupported_framework: iOS 16 and later: frameworks the app had not loaded cannot be decrypted
reason_repair_unsupported_watch: Watch app code cannot be decrypted on this device on iOS 16 and later
reason_repair_unsupported_other: iOS 16 and later: only executables of the app and its extensions can be decrypted
reason_repair_unsupported_extension: no system process could start this app extension
log_repair_retry: [{bundle}] {n} file(s) failed because of frida-server; restarting it and trying again…
reason_repair_unsupported_minos: it requires iOS {error}, so this device never loads it and it cannot be decrypted here
